toegepas.blok: Drie punte om na 'n dans te kyk
toegepas.voor: party vertel 'n storie en party vier iets saam
toegepas.na: party vertel 'n storie, en party vier iets saam
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (here the last of three such clauses).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('party vertel ...', 'party vier ...'), each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation-only fix that matches the comma the lesson already uses in 'Partykeer dans hulle sonder musiek, en partykeer speel'; wording and meaning unchanged, and no protected wording touched.

toegepas.voor: skoolspanne dans dit en besoekers kom dit sien
toegepas.na: skoolspanne dans dit, en besoekers kom dit sien
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (here the last of three such clauses).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('skoolspanne dans dit', 'besoekers kom dit sien').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation-only fix; it is not the earlier rejected rewording of 'besoekers kom dit sien', and the words and meaning stay exactly as they were.

toegepas.voor: een maat lei met sy bewegings en die ander volg hom
toegepas.na: een maat lei met sy bewegings, en die ander volg hom
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects ('een maat lei', 'die ander volg').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('een maat lei', 'die ander volg hom').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain punctuation correction inside a lesson-local definition that is not on the shared or decided list; it rewords nothing and leaves the protected 'lei-en-volg' and 'In beweging:' label intact.

vlae.teks: 'n ander herhaal presies wat een persoon of groep pas gedoen het.
vlae.rede: 'n ander' comes before the 'persoon of groep' it is contrasted with, so on a first reading it has no clear referent; not changed because 'herhaal presies' is protected and a reorder would split it.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The fixed definition 'Een persoon of groep sing of speel 'n kort deel en 'n ander antwoord daarop.' joins two clauses with their own subjects and verbs, so under the AWS 2017 rule it needs a comma before 'en'; left unchanged because the wording is shared for the whole subject-grade.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Langs mekaar wys die drie punte hoe verskillend die twee danse is.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die drie punte wys hoe verskillend die twee danse langs mekaar is.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As written, 'langs mekaar' attaches to the three points rather than the two dances; the reorder fixes the reference without adding words.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The fronted 'Langs mekaar' reads naturally and echoes the heading; the reorder is a lateral move that now suggests the dances stand physically side by side.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Dit is die klem en nie die enigste
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dit is die klem, nie die enigste
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'en nie' makes the contrast read like an addition; a comma states the contrast directly and saves a word.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Dit is die klem en nie die enigste ...' is ordinary natural Afrikaans; the comma version is only different.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Opgemaakte' echoes English 'made-up'; 'versinde' is the standard Afrikaans word.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Opgemaakte' is established, plain Afrikaans (as in 'n opgemaakte storie'), while 'versinde' is harder for a Grade 5 reader and rewords a glossary definition for no clear gain.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die dans is na daardie stewels genoem
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die dans is na daardie stewels vernoem
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Na iets genoem' calques English 'named after'; the Afrikaans idiom is 'na iets vernoem'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Na iets genoem' is ordinary, correct Afrikaans (as in 'n kind na sy oupa noem), not a calque, so 'vernoem' is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: volg die span dikwels die maat
laat_vaar_vorige.na: volg die span dikwels die ritme
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Die maat volg' can be read as 'follow the partner', since the glossary uses 'maat' for a partner; 'ritme' is the lesson's own word for the beat and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die maat volg' is the fixed musical expression for keeping time to the musicians' beat, and changing it to 'ritme' swaps a term of art and moves the meaning in a lesson that sets the dancers' own rhythm against the music.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Dit is die klem en nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dit is elke dans se klem en nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The bare 'Dit' has no clear referent after two sentences about two dances; naming whose emphasis it is makes the reference clear without adding content.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: In context 'Dit is die klem' clearly refers to the two contrasts just named, and 'elke dans se klem' can be misread as a claim about every dance in general.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Kom kyk daarna' is the natural Afrikaans for going to watch a performance; 'kom dit sien' reads stiffly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Besoekers kom dit sien' is ordinary, acceptable Afrikaans, and 'kyk daarna' can also be read as 'look after it', so the proposal is a lateral move that adds an ambiguity.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sy' can be read as 'she' or 'his' and is unclear here; 'n beeld' gives the same image without the unclear pronoun.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Before a noun 'sy' can only be the possessive and clearly points to the partner, and swapping it for 'n beeld' drops whose reflection you are.
